body: Expert analog layouts differ from auto-generated ones in density and regularity, not only in legality: experts make a succession of discrete, hierarchical physical decisions and revisit each after extracted electrical results, while most existing automated flows act on a physical search space fixed before the controller runs. We present CASCoDe, a closed-loop LLM agent framework for analog netlist-to-layout design that formalizes those expert decisions as a hierarchical discrete action space-sizing selection, structural floorplan, local layout refinement, routing-attempt selection-on which the agent runs feedback-driven tree search from a circuit netlist to a verified GDS. The agent authors the circuit-specific floorplans and scripts, and an execution layer of interface adaptations over adapted tools make every action land at physical implementation and be judged by DRC, LVS, and extracted-RC simulation. On 20 SKY130 amplifiers spanning single-, two-, and three-stage topologies, CASCoDe is the only flow that delivers a DRC- and LVS-clean routed layout when meeting design specifications for every circuit. It reduces area by 59-85% (mean 71%) against a conventional P&R flow on identical PCells, raises mean device density from 0.39 to 0.74 against APPlace, MAGICAL, ALIGN and ICPI. A layout that beats every baseline in area and legality appears after 11 minutes of agent time on average, and ablations show that the structured action space and the feedback-guided tree search each reduce area and search cost.
summaryZh: CASCoDe：用于模拟尺寸调整和布局协同设计的闭环代理框架。专家模拟布局在密度和规律性方面与自动生成的布局不同，不仅在合法性方面：专家做出一系列离散的、分层的物理决策，并在提取电气结果后重新访问每个决策，而大多数现有的自动化流程作用于控制器运行之前固定的物理搜索空间。我们提出了 CASCoDe，一个用于模拟网表到布局设计的闭环 LLM 代理框架，它将这些专家决策形式化为分层离散操作空间大小选择、结构布局规划、局部布局细化、路由尝试选择，代理在其上运行从电路网表到经过验证的 GDS 的反馈驱动树搜索。
